verdict.rationale: Gram's evidence describes OAuth 2.0 provider integration and team/server/tool-level RBAC synced to an enterprise IDP (gram-docs-2, gram-gh-2), but nothing documents per-end-user connected accounts or scoped tokens so that each of a platform-engineer's own product's end users gets isolated credentials — the RBAC described is org/team-level, not end-user-level multi-tenant credential isolation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-end-user connected-account/token scoping, any multi-tenant credential isolation guide, and evidence of enforcement that one end user's agent cannot use another's credentials.
